name: Local preferences and saved prayer persistence
userOutcome: Keep onboarding choices, preferences, completions, and saved prayers locally across relaunches, and understand when durable storage is unavailable.
productionDataSource: UserDefaults for preferences and the app's on-device SwiftData store for completions and favorites.
errorBehavior: SwiftData mutations are committed before success behavior; failures roll back and show a recoverable message. If the durable store cannot open, a visible banner explains that changes will not survive closing the app.
accessibilityRequirements: Storage failure banner has a complete VoiceOver label.
Saved prayer rows remain normal buttons with readable labels.
Delete remains available through standard List actions.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not silently fall back to ephemeral storage.
Do not dismiss Save before the SwiftData operation succeeds.
Do not erase recoverable state after a failed delete.
Do not ship UI-test reset behavior in Release builds.
acceptanceTests: Release configuration compilation excludes the DEBUG-only reset hook
